sanskrit_verse:
सत्येन शापयेद् विप्रं क्षत्रियं वाहनायुधैः ।
गोरक्षकान् वाणिजकांस् तथाकारुकुशीलवान् ।
प्रेष्यान् वार्धुषिकांश् चैव विप्राञ् शूद्रवद् आचरेत् ॥
transliteration: satyena śāpayed vipraṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ | gorakṣakān vāṇijakāṃs tathākārukuśīlavān | preṣyān vārdhuṣikāṃś caiva viprāñ śūdravad ācaret ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Brahmin is to be disciplined through truth alone; the Kshatriya by conveyances and weapons; herders, traders, artisans, performers, servants, and vendors are to be guided accordingly; all other Brahmins must be treated as Shudras.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is contextually calibrated to varna-dharma capacity
Causation aligns with role-based consciousness manifestation
Restoration logic follows varna-specific dharma alignment
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor = Brahmin THEN discipline_method = satyena
IF actor = Kshatriya THEN discipline_method = vahanayudhaih
IF actor IN [gorakshaka, vanija, akaru, kushila] THEN discipline_method = role_aligned_guidance
IF actor = Brahmin AND behavior_violates_dharma THEN treatment_standard = shudra_level
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, varna-specific dharma capacity determines both threshold of responsibility and nature of corrective measure. The court must ensure alignment between actor's constitutional role and the restorative mechanism applied, rejecting punitive equivalence in favor of consciousness recalibration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based causality establishes that each varna manifests dharma through distinct instrumentalities. Anupurva reveals sequential misalignment requiring targeted restoration. Responsibility is proportional to role-capacity. Non-punitive reality rule confirms suffering is not justice but distortion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Truth-disclosure protocol for Brahmin actors to restore satya-vakya alignment
Kshatriya reconditioning via symbolic reintegration with duty-tools
Brahmin-to-Shudra conduct reset when dharma violation breaches consciousness threshold
Consciousness-responsibility audit for all actors post-restoration
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through varna-aligned discipline. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
